women_pct.note: Not published: the Class of 2027 profile page no longer prints a count or share of women, read in a browser on 2026-09-27. The 49.4 percent once recorded here was computed from the 39 female students of 79 enrolled it used to print (INC-0154).

intl_pct.note: Not published: the Class of 2027 profile page no longer prints a count or share of international students, read in a browser on 2026-09-27. The 16.5 percent once recorded here was computed from the 13 international students of 79 enrolled it used to print (INC-0154).

salary_median_usd.stat: average starting salary, Classes of 2023-2025 aggregate; median not published

employment_rate_pct.stat: received offers within three months of graduation, Classes of 2023-2025 aggregate

notes: The class profile page used to print women and international students as counts (39 and 13 of 79 enrolled); it no longer prints either, so both shares are empty (INC-0154). GRE averages and acceptance rate are not published on the official pages. Salary is an average, not a median; school does not publish a median. Employment and salary figures are a three-class aggregate labeled Classes of 2023-2025 on the page.
